name: Rendement Production Huilerie
query: SELECT date_production AS `Date:Date:100`, name AS `Production:Link/Production Huilerie:180`, type_production AS `Type:Data:140`, lot_reference AS `Lot:Data:140`, quantite_entree AS `Entrée:Float:110`, quantite_produite AS `Produite:Float:110`, pertes AS `Pertes:Float:100`, rendement_pct AS `Rendement %:Percent:120` FROM `tabProduction Huilerie` WHERE docstatus=1 ORDER BY date_production DESC
